name: llm-compiler
title: Plan tool calls as a graph and run independent ones in parallel

comparison.purpose: A planner writes every tool call up front with its dependencies, independent lookups run at the same time, and a joiner answers or asks for a new plan. The machine reads each task's dependencies from its $N references, checks the plan only points backward before running it, records which wave each task started in, and caps replanning with MAX_REPLANS instead of a recursion limit.
